category: Restaurants / Gourmet Truffle Burger & Craft Diner

contact.address: 212/A, 1st Main Rd, Stage 2, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560071

colour_palette.details: No dedicated website exists. While physical packaging uses gold foil and noir black (#D4AF37, #111111), there is zero digital design token infrastructure.

logo.details: No vector web logo or favicon deployed on an owned domain.

typography.details: Non-existent website typography. Trapped within standard Swiggy/Zomato third-party font templates.

contact.details: Direct cloud kitchen phone number available on Google Maps, active social media handle.

online_presence.details: Completely reliant on third-party food delivery aggregators (Swiggy/Zomato) paying 25-30% platform commissions. Zero owned customer data or DTC ordering flow.

verdict.commercial_rationale: High-end luxury burger brand with high average order values (₹600–₹1,200). A premium dark-mode cinematic direct ordering platform will recapture tens of thousands in aggregator commission fees and establish an elite digital presence.

sample_website.notes: Noir luxury aesthetic showcasing Truffle Takeover, Monster Cheese, and Gold Leaf Wagyu Smash burgers.
